godel.why: probes start processes and read the host (GODEL_AUDIT §4.3: probes NO)

name: honest_limits

pipeline.tier_reason: a probe is a direct observation of this host; the sections that depend on one report unavailable or inconclusive with its reason: exhaustive over the tools this host has

statement: Honest limits: what cannot run here is reported with its reason, a check with nothing to check is vacuous (never a pass), and every engine that claims something states its limits.
usefulness: A pass can be trusted: the model never reports a success it did not check.
